test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held On: 30 June, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct indirect narration of the given sentence.

Aravind said, “Let us wait for the cab.”

options.text: Aravind proposed that they should wait for the cab.
Aravind proposed that they should has wait for the cab.
Aravind proposes that let we waited for the cab.
Aravind propose that they should been wait for the cab.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Aravind proposed that they should wait for the cab**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **“Let” **is used to mean “to allow”.
 
• **“Say/ Said” **in Direct Speech is changed into **“Propose/ Proposed”**, “Suggest/ Suggested” etc.
 
• &a
